description: This file contains Sass mixins related to Font Awesome icons and accessibility helpers (screen reader-only styling).

methods.name: fa-icon
methods.description: Mixin for styling Font Awesome icons with default font styles.

methods.name: fa-icon-rotate
methods.description: Mixin to apply rotation transformations to icons.

methods.name: fa-icon-flip
methods.description: Mixin to flip icons horizontally or vertically with optional rotation.

methods.name: sr-only
methods.description: Mixin to visually hide content but keep it accessible to screen readers.

methods.name: sr-only-focusable
methods.description: Mixin to make hidden content focusable and visible when focused or active.
